Class MenuController

java.lang.Object
controller.MenuController
public class MenuController extends Object
This controller manages the menu view, populating the drinks and toppings tables. It allows the user to add or edit drinks and toppings by opening the respective forms when a row is double-clicked or when the add buttons are clicked

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      private void initialize()
      Initializes the menu view by configuring the table columns, setting up row click handlers, and refreshing the data displayed in the tables. This method is called automatically after the FXML file has been loaded.

    • refresh

      public void refresh()
      Refreshes the data displayed in the drinks and toppings tables by retrieving the latest data from the model. This method is called after a drink or topping is added, edited, or deleted.

    • configure_columns

      private void configure_columns()
      Configures the columns of the drinks and toppings tables to display the appropriate data from the model. This method is called during initialization of the controller.

    • open_drink_form

      private void open_drink_form(javafx.stage.Window owner, MenuDrinksRowDTO existing)
      Opening logic for the AddMenuDrinkController, kept separate from the main open drink to allow for separate logic for adding vs editing drinks
      Parameters:
      owner - the window that owns the form to prevent multiple windows from being opened at once
      existing - the drink being edited, or null when adding a drink
